policy: Do not import a source into a pie or detail file when its period, schema, access response, or own total cannot be validated. Keep the official lead and failure reason here for later retry.

entries.reason: The official FY2024 top-level category table now validates exactly, but the agency-category drill-down remains deferred; the combined detail route was not imported.
Official FY2024 transaction ZIP returned 403; the official comparative activity statement was used only as an aggregate fallback.

The cabinet/branch hierarchy is now reproducible and imported; statewide vendor detail remains deferred because the official API reports 381,730 records and caps the detailed response/export at 10,000 rows.
Vendor detail remains interactive; no period-aligned machine-readable vendor export was validated.
Mass.gov guidance route returned an internal error; the separate official CTHRU Socrata dataset was validated.

Production Checkbook route returned 502 during the original validation and now serves a Tableau sign-in page; an official aggregate agency/fund layer was validated separately.
PennWATCH timed out during bounded validation; no transaction amount was inferred from the portal.

Official FY2024 OpenBooks export is multi-gigabyte and was not validated row-by-row; ACFR activity rows remain the aggregate fallback.
The official TOPS Tableau CSV returned current-period rows; documented FY2024 filter attempts did not produce a period-aligned export, so ACFR activity rows remain the validated fallback.
Public CSV is stale at FY2014–FY2018 and was not used for FY2024.
